stages.reason: Restored the lineage (370 heads, 190 PRs indexed by the prior run; newest branch research/unified-solver-referee-20261124 at abf29825 contains the supplied a8d196b4); reproduced the base: entry tests and facade suite 571/0/1; re-derived five closed-form claims of the prior run (C1-C5 PASS).

Separated what dominates a RODAS5P step per regime from the V04 cost anatomy: RHS only with an expensive RHS; sweeps in 1D banded; factorisation in 2D/3D banded and dense; Krylov in matrix-free.

Hypothesis space for exact-stage parallelism: two-way, alternating-orientation wavefront, SPIKE-P with fallback, separable sphere solver, parallel dense LU; mapped each project idea to each solver family.
Derived SL-1 (stage-row lattice depths 16n, 9n+c, 8n+c, 16n/P+c) and SL-2 (two-way = partial pivoting of a reordered matrix).
Checked SL-1 on 30 exact affine fits and SL-2 on 30 seeded systems against an independent dense elimination and LAPACK gbsv.
Discriminating measurement: stage pattern and whole solves of tight, two-way serial and two-way join against the protected kernel, three tries, diagnostic host.

Formal contracts of BandedStagePolicy and StagePolicy (refusal predicates, records, executed tier); SolveSpec design for the single frontend.
Machine-readable follow-up DAG SL-N1..SL-N14 with acceptance, kill and fallback; coding-agent prompt.

Baseline on the base commit: entry tests of the prior plan and the full facade suite with the structured feature.
Defect probes: split forcing versus the ordinary composite RHS on out-of-domain trial states (no defect; contract tests added); pre-existing clippy failure in ppsw1_independent_qualification fixed.
Bounded design: three alternatives (SPIKE-P, wavefront driver, two-way client); two-way chosen because it needs no driver or callback change and keeps partial pivoting.
Implemented BandedTwoWayStageLu (serial and joined fronts, tight-kernel delegation below threshold, no allocation after construction).
Facade wiring: BandedStagePolicy, VigilODE::solve_banded, StagePolicy, VigilODE::solve_stages, DriverWork::BandedClient, Unsupported::BandedPolicyRequiresBandedRoute; default routes untouched.
Software validation: unit, integration, facade and golden tests; clippy -D warnings on both crates; rustfmt on changed files.
Numerical validation: backward error, serial/join bit identity, whole-IVP agreement in tolerance units; diagnostic timing.
Self-review of the diff (pivot windows, middle-block indexing, refusal before callbacks, tier record). An independent reviewer was not dispatched: recorded as NOT_RUN for independence.
Closeout: research branch commit and push, plan and prompt.

claims.statement: Stage-row lattice depth of one banded attempt: 16n (one orientation), 9n+c (alternating), 8n+c (two-way), 16n/P+c (SPIKE-P).
Two-way elimination is partial pivoting of Q W Q^T; no pivot is restricted.
BandedStagePolicy::TwoWay returns the same bits with one and two workers and tracks the protected driver within 1e-2 tolerance units on the tested problems.
Two-way stage pattern 0.54-0.61 of the protected kernel at n = 2e5 with two threads; whole-solve gain over the tight kernel not shown.
